Remark
[Intrinsic curvature derivative bounds] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0099 1. ch29:29.9\group Pressure Estimates

The curvature derivative estimates give $|\nabla _g^mR|_g\le C_m$ for $t\le -1$, but do not directly bound the derivatives measured with the round metric.
